title: EAP: Fix dissection of encrypted IMSI identifiers
description:
Adjusted EAP dissection to properly dissect the
prefix byte for encrypted IMSI identifiers and post the correct
fields for encrypted IMSI identifier strings which do not follow
the same string format as all other EAP identifiers. Closes #16528.

notes.body: mentioned in issue #16528
Space before `2`.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5639/diffs?diff_id=303706491&start_sha=3126a3132b29211f6dfc83af711611104d1a9257#ba9dfaa312dd0a4a184369963ee705299af82832_846_846)

Instead of all those `if (enc_imsi)` I would suggest: 1 single branch with all the dissections, or (preferred)

```c
if (enc_imsi)
  dissect_enc_imsi(...)
else
  dissect_plain_imsi(...)
```

There's quite a lot of overlapping logic in dissect_eap_identity_wlan() so it would be zero sum to split the functions in two.  I thought of that a year ago when I authored the original patch before the August 2020 migration to gitlab :smile: I could make that change if it was absolutely necessary, though.
Ok, if you have already gone through this, I can accept it as is.
Do you have a sample capture to share?

Yes.  See here.
